title: Variable indices in the CNF encoding
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, with size equal to $n$ plus its number of gates. Every literal in every clause of the CNF formula obtained from $C$ has variable index strictly less than $\mathrm{size}(C)$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs
